classificationNotes: Source-draft Fae are treated as a progressively alien wild-growth spirit visual and encounter-production family. Claims about wild-wood origin, beauty, friendliness, court, culture, cognition, agency, personhood, and hostility remain proposals pending taxonomy review. Leaf, bark, and branch are ordinary source materials, not a current Wood affinity.
visualConstants: A slender weightless-looking silhouette retains layered wings while scale, head growth, and proportion change only at explicit tiers.
Spring green, petal pink, dusk violet, moth iridescence, and bounded gold pollen light remain source palette rather than affinity evidence.
Living leaf, petal, spider silk, stained glass, bark, dew, and moth wing remain discrete ordinary or uncanny materials.
Wing complexity and subtly wrong beauty escalate from a palm sprite to a sovereign whose geometry bends the surrounding frame.
escalationAxis: Wing construction, scale, court ornament, and perceptual strangeness progress from a thorn-bearing sprite to a season-transforming sovereign.

constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity wild-wood imagery, ordinary leaf, bark, and branches, glowing pollen or glowing motes, dew, stained glass, and T5 reality bending remain source-supported material, ornament, light, and perceptual behavior—not retired Wood affinity or any current elemental affinity.
Petals, spider silk, moth wing, thorn, garland, antlers, masks, and restrained seasonal color retain crisp physical or uncanny boundaries without elemental substitution.
normal.counterplaySignal: The established wing root, petal seam, antler reflection, mask edge, or season-crown break remains readable.
forbidden: Treating ordinary plants, pollen light, dew, or stained glass as affinity evidence

Motion/process branches: T1 the palm-sized thorn feint vents one dust-sized combustion cycle between insect wings; T2 layered petals burn outer-to-inner; T3 stained glass and antlers redirect heat along one pane; T4 the gown and mask court cycle smoke through a clasp; T5 the season crown ignites and cools one stable reality facet.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe attention with one palm-sized thorn thrust hidden behind a short dust trail.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the simple insect wings pause before the thorn commits and expose their shared root.
forms.signatureMechanic: Dust Feint: a brief trail of glowing dust continues forward while the Pixie stops and thrusts its thorn across the trail.
forms.telegraph: The simple insect wings close together and the gold dust stream continues one body length without the Pixie.
forms.counterplay: Ignore the continuing dust and strike the shared wing root during the stopped thrust.
forms.visualDelta: Palm-sized Pixie with simple insect wings, a thorn sword, and a bounded trail of glowing dust.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Repeat fan-shaped pressure by folding layered petal wings around a knee-high thorn advance.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the outer petal closes first and leaves the inner seam exposed after the fan.
forms.signatureMechanic: Garland Fan: layered petals close outer-to-inner while the thorn blade traces the same narrowing lane.
forms.telegraph: Garland clothing draws tight and the outer petal layer tilts toward the selected side.
forms.counterplay: Cross behind the outer petal and strike the inner wing seam after the blade passes.
forms.visualDelta: Knee-high Sprite with layered petal wings, garland clothing, thorn blade, and a faint aura of motes.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Pixies leave dust on the fan edge; breaking the petal seam disperses the feint.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a refractive lane controller whose stained-glass wings and branch antlers cast conflicting route signs.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach players to compare antler shadow with glass color and take the unreflected lane.
forms.signatureMechanic: False Rose Path: one antler frames a colored wing pane, projecting three apparent thrust lanes while only the pane without an antler reflection carries the leaf-armored charge.
forms.telegraph: The unnervingly still face turns last, one woven antler crosses a stained-glass pane, and two reflected lanes brighten.
forms.counterplay: Take the pane with no antler reflection and strike the rigid wing rib after the charge passes.
forms.visualDelta: Human-sized Fae Knight with stained-glass wings, antlers of woven branches, leaf-and-bark armor, and an unnervingly still face.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Sprites fan petals across reflected lanes; cutting their inner seam reveals the true pane early.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control alternating court sectors by turning a mask-like face while a mote court lifts one living-gown hem.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the crown and mask point in different directions and only the lifted gown seam carries the command.
forms.signatureMechanic: Still Court: the thorn-and-blossom crown names one sector, the no-white eyes fix another, and motes lift the living leaf gown over the actual command lane.
forms.telegraph: The mask face stays still as one gown hem rises and the hovering court condenses beneath it.
forms.counterplay: Follow the lifted hem rather than the gaze and cut the exposed living seam after the court passes.
forms.visualDelta: Living leaf-and-flower gown, mask-like face without eye whites, hovering mote court, and crown of thorns and blossom.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Fae Knights project false lanes across the court; breaking their glass rib clears the commanded sector.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Transform a four-season arena with impossible geometry while each crown quarter restages a learned lower-form deception.
forms.teachingGoal: Test dust feints, petal seams, reflected paths, and court tells while each solved season restores one stable route through bent reality.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Transformation — Simultaneous Seasons: one quarter of the season crown turns toward the viewer, impossible wing geometry folds that quadrant, and a lower Fae performs its learned rule inside the faint reality bend.
forms.telegraph: One seasonal crown quarter advances, a shattered-rainbow wing folds through an impossible angle, and the called lower form appears on the last stable line.
forms.counterplay: Answer the lower-form tell and break the exposed crown quarter; each broken season straightens one arena route and removes that transformation.
forms.visualDelta: Fae Monarch with impossible geometry in limbs and wings, a crown cycling through four seasons at once, shattered-rainbow wings, and faint reality bending around the silhouette.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Pixie, Sprite, Fae Knight, and Fae Noble each author one seasonal deception; resolving it exposes the linked crown quarter.
